data.authority: build bookkeeping only; not release approval
risks: This is a measured prototype: three document positions followed by executable slices, six to twenty-four stages. Arbitrary semantic role/type routing is not implemented.
One frozen executable oracle is reused in this slice. Later-stage passage does not by itself demonstrate a new feature or semantic adequacy of the oracle.
Reference/structure checks do not establish document semantics; architecture and contract review remain required and are not release authority.

Model replies and boundary probe in the integration fixture are explicit test doubles. The program execution is real; live-model performance, host isolation and advanced-project success were not measured.
Windows loopback isolation is unresolved. Measurement-only stays REVIEW, dependents stop and the workflow issues no checkpoint or deployment.
Unknown workers retain their lease for explicit reconciliation; generic automatic crash recovery and additional providers remain later work.
CLI is connected to the shared service; a standalone nontechnical chat UI and measured owner-effort/cost reductions are not claimed.
